topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: I hear the lord's steward speaks of turning the common quarters into separate holdings, each with its own master. It's a strange notion, like dividing a single field among many, each to till as they see fit. I wonder what it means for the community, for the balance we've kept. Perhaps it's a change for the better, a way to plant and reap according to one's own hand. I trust the saints will guide us, as they have in years past, and we'll find a way to work together, just as we always have. The earth doesn’t care who owns the land; it gives according to the effort put into it.
